verdicts.rationale: Harrison2007 is a byte-identical duplicate import of harrison2007extraclassical: same title, authors, year, NeuroImage vol 34(3), pp 1199-1208, same DOI. Loser not indexed.
Harvey2017 duplicates harvey2017network exactly: same title, authors, Nature Human Behaviour vol 1(2), same DOI. Loser not indexed.
Hatfield2003 is field-identical to hatfield2003representation (same title, author, Acta Psychologica 114(3):355-378, same DOI). Loser not indexed.

Same essay 'Representational Genera' but two distinct publications: 1991 original in 'Philosophy and Connectionist Theory' (Erlbaum, pp 61-91) vs 2019 reprint in 'Philosophy And The Computer' (Routledge, pp 105-134, own DOI). BOTH are deepIndexed with folders — merging would archive real indexed work on a substantively different publication. Keep separate.
hawkins2023visual duplicates hawkins2023disentangling: identical title, authors, Nat Commun 14(1), same DOI (loser just adds page 2199). Loser indexed_state none.
Healey2007 is field-identical to healey2007graphical (same title, authors, Cognitive Science 31(2):285-309, same DOI). Loser not indexed.

Heil2019 vs heil2019philosophy: same title, author, publisher, same DOI; years differ (2012 vs 2019) suggesting different editions, but the loser is indexed_state none and only the survivor is deepIndexed, so merge into the most-indexed per edition rule.
Heinze2018 is byte-identical to heinze2018principles (same title, authors, Current Biology 28(17):R1043-R1058, same DOI). Loser not indexed.
Henderson2024 duplicates henderson2024shared (same title, authors, Mind & Language 39(4):454-471, same DOI; only a unicode hyphen differs in an author name). Loser not indexed.

hiddleston1977causal is the preprint ('forthcoming in Nous') of hiddleston2005causal, the published Nous article of the same title/author. Preprint vs published = same work per rubric; merge into the DOI-bearing published survivor.

verdicts.id: on the coherence and structure of discourse
verdicts.rationale: hobbs1985b (techreport CSLI-85-37) is the published form of hobbs1985coherence (same title, author, year); the tech report and the manuscript are the same work. Loser not indexed.

notes1990literature and hobbs1990literature are the same book: same title 'Literature and cognition', author Hobbs, 1990, CSLI (Lecture Notes 21); the two ISBNs (9780937073537 / 0937073539) are the ISBN-13 and ISBN-10 of the same volume. Merge under the canonical hand key.
